IGUI_OFP_ExpandNoGrowth: No larger connected area was found. The safehouse is unchanged.
IGUI_OFP_ExpandPermission: Only the owner or an authorized administrator can enlarge this safehouse.
IGUI_OFP_ExpandOutside: Stand inside the current safehouse and try again.
IGUI_OFP_ExpandUnloaded: Connected rooms are not fully loaded. Move closer and try again.
IGUI_OFP_ExpandOverlap: The larger area would overlap another safehouse. Nothing was changed.
IGUI_OFP_ExpandBusy: Please wait briefly before trying again.
IGUI_OFP_ExpandWar: A safehouse involved in a war cannot be enlarged.
IGUI_OFP_ExpandLimit: The connected area is too large to process safely. Nothing was changed.
IGUI_OFP_ExpandNoStructure: No enclosed, roofed connected rooms were found. Nothing was changed.
IGUI_OFP_ExpandMissing: This safehouse has changed or no longer exists. Reopen its window.
IGUI_OFP_ExpandFailed: The safehouse could not be enlarged.
IGUI_OFP_ExpandTimeout: No confirmation arrived. Reopen the safehouse window to check its boundaries.
IGUI_OFP_ExpandTooltip: Recalculates the safehouse using connected enclosed, roofed rooms, including extensions to map buildings. Only a larger area is accepted; the current area is never reduced. The server confirms success or rejection. Owner or authorized administrator only; stand inside the safehouse. All connected rooms must be loaded and the new area must not overlap another safehouse. Other safehouses limit only the blocked directions; free directions can still grow.
